name: RobotMsg
meaning: Messages handled by Robot_HandleMessage 0x460b93 (sender, id, arg)

name: MSG_KILL
meaning: Sam + EJECTTRAJ → eject (state 0x11); arg 0 from others → die (0x10 for FireBall, else 0xF); always returns 1

name: MSG_PICKUP
meaning: Magnet: hang 75 below joint; else carried by Ralph (state 2)

name: MSG_DROP
meaning: detach, face away from dropper, SetPosition unless flag bit 1, state 1

name: MSG_SEESAW_TOUCH
meaning: with 0x25: end of launch/throw → state 1, or 7 if controlled and in 0x15

name: MSG_FREEZE
meaning: suspend control (third party) or release to the Wolf

name: MSG_TRAP_STATE
meaning: arg 0 (trap released): clear TRAPPED/STRUGGLE; arg 1 ignored

name: MSG_REMOTE_SWITCH
meaning: from RemoteControl: arg 1 take control, arg 0 release

name: MSG_STRUGGLE
meaning: WolfTrap relays each Action press: STRUGGLE flag

name: MSG_MAGNET_QUERY
meaning: → 1 (meaning unknown) -- the magnet update 0x4d235e pulls only candidates that answer nonzero; the Robot always answers 1 (it is magnetic)
